name: aerial
description: Read, draw and write on your Aerial whiteboard from Claude.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Aerial desktop whiteboard on your Mac. Claude can read the open board, draw shapes and arrows, add Mermaid diagrams and typed text, write notes with real pen strokes, and take a snapshot to check its work. Everything runs on your machine through a private local socket; nothing is sent to a server. Requires the Aerial app (macOS).
